summary: Added meterbill/money.py with all rounding rules, rewired tariffs/standing/tax/cash/credits/report to use it, removed the decimal-context line, and added tests/test_money.py; CLI output matched the original on randomized books/accounts/quotes. Preserved quirks: batch worker threads used the default half-even context, so batch band charges and effective price still round half even (via keyword-only method args) while bill/quote round half up; cash 'whole' never prints a negative zero; arithmetic that exceeds 28 digits was context-rounded before and is not replicated.
